correctness.rationale: The cut lower bound gives cp >= q^2+3q. A quadratic-character split of K_q and invertible maps T_r({x,y})={x+ry,rx+y} pair the four cellwise internal-edge classes into q(q-1) edge-disjoint K4 blocks; the nonsquare factor guarantees that no crossing edge repeats. Exactly 4q crossing edges remain as K2 blocks, giving equality. The cc=4 proof uses the four natural cell cliques and an induced K_{2,2} witness. The k == 3 (mod 4) obstruction follows from equality cases of both oriented cut inequalities and the handshake lemma.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The direct 2026 source arXiv:2608.11536 determines G_{h,k} exactly for even k with h >= k-1, while this result treats h=2 and odd prime powers q == 1 (mod 4). Exact, synonymous, finite-field, and design-language searches found no prior statement of the formula or congruence obstruction. Older design literature remains a residual equivalence risk.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact infinite family in a regime omitted by the newest construction, introduces a different finite-field mechanism, and proves a complementary parity obstruction showing that cut-bound attainment at h=2 has genuine arithmetic structure.
